Set up GitHits for your agents

Run this command:

<> bash
npx githits@latest init

What happens next:

  1. Opens your browser to authorize GitHits
  2. Asks whether to set up GitHits at the user or project level
  3. Detects your supported AI coding tools
  4. Lets you choose which tools to configure
  5. Configures the selected tools

Having trouble? Check our documentation.
